summary: Tech led Tuesday's session higher, with S&P futures up 0.7% and chip names running on fresh AI demand. AMD hit a new record after Citi raised its target to $800, while small caps lagged the mega-cap move.
market_note: Futures green across the board: S&P +0.68%, Nasdaq +0.68%, Dow +0.46%. Gold up 0.83% to 4,191.30 while VIX fell 2.64%.

items.why: Citi hiked its price target to a Street-high $800 today, citing AI agent demand, while Mizuho raised to $705. CEO Lisa Su said in Taiwan that AMD will substantially increase chip supply in 2027 on very high demand.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

Melius Research upgraded Microsoft to Buy with a $665 target, calling it the adults in charge of AI, and Scotiabank raised its target to $615. The stock is near record highs after its best quarter since 1998.
